'''Shi Jianlin''' ({{zh|s=施剑林}}) is a Chinese chemist specializing in [[inorganic chemistry]].<ref name="fish"/>

==Early life and education==
Shi was born in [[Taicang]], [[Jiangsu]] in 1964.<ref>{{cite news|author1=Yu Hanqi ({{lang|zh|虞涵棋}})|url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_5031527 |script-title=zh:新当选中科院院士籍贯盘点：江苏9人居首，湖南8人湖北6人 |work=Thepaper |date=November 22, 2019 |accessdate=December 17, 2019 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1983 he graduated from [[Nanjing Tech University]].<ref name="lion">{{cite news|url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_5032092 |script-title=zh:重磅！我校校友施剑林、涂善东分别当选中国科学院、中国工程院院士！ |work=thepaper |date=22 November 2019 |accessdate=25 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1989 he received his doctor's degree from the Shanghai Institute of Ceramics, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS) under the supervision of [[Yan Dongsheng]].<ref>{{cite news|author1=Shi Jianlin|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2016/9/356957.shtm |script-title=zh:施剑林：沉痛悼念我的导师严东生先生 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=23 September 2016 |accessdate=25 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Career==
He is now a researcher and doctoral supervisor at the Shanghai Institute of Ceramics, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS).<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.sic.cas.cn/gkjj/lrld/sjl/ |script-title=zh:施剑林 |work=sic.cas.cn |date=2015 |accessdate=25 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 2008 "[[Changjiang Scholars Program|Chang Jiang Scholar]]" (or "Yangtze River Scholar")<ref name="lion"/> 
* 2011 State Natural Science Award (Second Class)<ref name="lion"/> 
* 2016 Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]]<ref name="lion"/> 
* November 22, 2019 Academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="fish">{{cite news|url=https://news.ifeng.com/c/7rnt6gRXMxD |script-title=zh:2019年中科院院士增选结果揭晓，64人当选，最小年龄42岁 |work=ifeng |date=22 November 2019 |accessdate=22 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
